app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.24 GAME TRACE
app.long_description: Experimental PS2 game diagnostic build. Bounded GIF/XGKICK/SIGNAL, VIF and interrupt history, unknown VU pairs and CPU wait context in numbered SD session logs. Retains BETA12.23 corrections. Both experiments factory OFF; saved settings apply at Cold Boot. No confirmed Crash/Tekken gameplay or SIGNAL stall resolution. Keep BETA12.23 for rollback. Bring your own legal BIOS/disc.
